neighbours.label: catalogue-style specifications of industrial machinery and its parts
fire: The ball mill adopts a welded frame with reliable sealing and low maintenance cost.
This gearbox has the characteristics of stable transmission, high torque and long service life.
The conveyor can be fitted with 2-6 rollers according to customer requirements and load.
The spindle uses alloy bearings, and the hydraulic system ensures smooth feeding precision.
Our vibrating screen features simple structure, large capacity and convenient installation.
The cutter head is made of tungsten carbide with excellent wear resistance and hardness.
The stamping press is equipped with a servo motor and an automatic lubrication device.
The boiler tube bundle adopts seamless pipe, with high thermal efficiency and compact layout.
quiet: The old mill stopped running in 1950 and the village slowly emptied out afterwards.
My grandfather fixed the gearbox himself one rainy weekend and drove to town on Monday.
The conveyor broke down on Friday, so everybody at the airport waited for their bags.
A mechanic spent the morning talking about bearings with a customer he knew from school.
Our new sofa is soft and comfortable, and the children love sitting on it after school.
The kitchen knife was a wedding gift from her aunt and she still uses it every day.
The noisy press next door kept us awake, so we complained to the landlord in writing.
The boiler in our flat went out at midnight and we slept in coats until the morning.

notes: Top examples are translated-English product text for machines and tooling. Probes: 0.20-0.43 on such text, 0.03 on a garden and a concert. Near misses keep machines or products but in plain narrative or consumer style.
